neighbours.label: the subject or verb inside an 'of which X is/are' relative clause (of which you are aware, of which he is president), as against the same content in 'which X verb' or 'that X verb' clauses
fire: Report any conflicts of interest of which you are aware.
The club, of which she is treasurer, raised money for the shelter.
The band, of which I was the drummer, split up in 1998.
The firm, of which he is a partner, handled the merger.
Name any risks of which we are not yet informed.
The council, of which they are members, voted against the plan.
The journal, of which Smith was founding editor, closed last year.
This is the only house of which my mother is still the owner.
quiet: Report any conflicts of interest that you notice.
The club, which she runs, raised money for the shelter.
The band that I played drums for split up in 1998.
The firm, which he joined, handled the merger.
Name any risks that we have not yet discussed.
The council, which they joined, voted against the plan.
The journal that Smith founded closed last year.
This is the only house that my mother still owns.
